Reasoning: This release stage commands only gripper opening while holding the end-effector pose fixed. The freeze_position term represents keeping the panda_fingertip origin at its current world-frame position with no commanded linear motion. The freeze_orientation term represents preserving the current world-frame orientation, including the current tool +z and +y directions, with no commanded angular motion. The open_gripper term represents commanding both finger joints toward the fully open state and using the gripper_opened condition as the supported success signal for the release command. A manipulator_low_effort condition is included with the fixed-pose maintenance to reflect monitoring for absence of unexpected arm/TCP contact or effort spikes during release. Finger-specific effort dropping to free-space levels, explicit confirmation of cube_3 supported contact on cube_2, and checking cube_3 toppling/slipping or cube_1-specific contact are not directly representable with the available operators, so they are noted here but omitted from the Constraints.
